reviews.text:
I couldn't be more grateful to have discovered this veterinary clinic! ❤️

It's certainly not the first vet I've consulted, but it's the first time I've felt so comfortable and confident in a clinic.

Here, you never feel like just a number. You genuinely feel how much the entire team loves animals and cares about their well-being. I truly feel that they love and care for my little Bella as if she were their own dog, and for me, that's priceless.

I especially want to highlight the exceptional work of Dr. Katia Ryers. She is an incredible veterinarian, both for her skills and her dedication. She managed to detect an illness in my dog ​​that several other vets had missed. I can't thank her enough for discovering it in time. ❤️

For the first time, I truly feel that my dog ​​is in the best possible hands. My trust in Dr. Ryers and her team is immense, and it's so reassuring to be able to entrust my pet to such competent and caring people.

I drive several hours each time to come to this clinic, and I will continue to do so without hesitation, because it's absolutely worth it!

All the staff are incredibly kind, the service is exceptional, and their love for animals is palpable with every visit.

I am so happy to have finally found a clinic I completely trust. A huge thank you to the entire team and especially to Dr. Ryers for everything you do for my dog. ❤️
Parking challenging.

Amazing vet clinic! Everyone there is so caring, knowledgeable, and genuinely compassionate. They take such wonderful care of our two senior Chihuahuas, and I truly feel like they always go the extra mile for them.

We definitely lucked out when we moved to the neighbourhood and had to find a new vet. We’re so grateful we found them!

Thank you to everyone at the clinic, and especially to Dr. Cammisano and Dr. Rayes over the past month, as well as the wonderful technicians and receptionists, particularly Milan. I lost two cats within three weeks, and these people were incredibly empathetic and kind. I've been coming to you for my animals for over a year now, and I'm so happy I found you! Thank you all for your compassion and kindness; I wouldn't go anywhere else to care for my beloved pets. See you soon! I have many other furry little darlings at home, and I wouldn't entrust them to anyone else but you, with complete confidence! From the bottom of my heart, thank you again! Line Lalonde

Absolutely amazing veterinary clinic! They went above and beyond to help me with a hurt cat during a very stressful incident. Their team shows so much heart and genuine care for animals. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate care. Thank you for everything!

I have nothing but praise for the Saint-Henri Veterinary Clinic. They agreed to see my "Patch" as an emergency, and their compassion for animals and their clients is undeniable. Thank you to the entire team.

We ended up at this vet by chance after our cat broke bones in his paw. What an amazing Vet, we can not thank them enough for the great care Natsu received. They are so compassionate and they truly care about animals. They were will to stay open late for us twice and  we were able to get same day appointments. I highly recommend them, everyone was so pleasant and kind at this place. Natsu thanks you for your amazing help in getting him better.

This clinic is by far the best vet we have ever dealt with. The effort, the time and the patience the staff put into our dog Chloe, preparing her for her relocation to Australia was amazing and we are so grateful for it. The process was extremely tedious and demanding, but they always remained patient, cordial and most of all, caring for Chloe. I really really recommend this clinic to anyone, but especially to those who have anxious dogs, since they really take their time to make them feel comfortable and loved.
Awesome people awesome facility! They are kind and understanding, they also worked with me, as I'm on a tight budget!.. theybwhere amazing!... looking forward to returning!!

I can’t say enough good things about Clinique Vétérinaire Saint-Henri and the kindness they showed our family during one of the hardest days we’ve ever experienced.

We came to them after a very difficult experience elsewhere, desperate to understand what was happening with our cat Luna. After testing, we learned that she had cancer and sadly had to make the heartbreaking decision to put her down.

I had just given birth, so I was there with my newborn son and my husband, completely overwhelmed and devastated. The entire team was incredibly kind, patient and considerate. They gave us the space and time we needed to cry, hold Luna and say goodbye to her peacefully. We never felt rushed or like we were just another appointment.

Afterward, they sent us a clipping of her fur and two paw prints. It was such a thoughtful gesture and meant more to me than I can explain. I look at her paw print every single day.

I will always be grateful to Dr. Killens and the team for the compassion and dignity they showed Luna, and for the kindness they showed our family during such a painful moment. Thank you for helping us give our girl a peaceful goodbye.

My experience with the clinic is recent and speaks volumes about the wonderful team who work there. After moving, we were looking for a new veterinary clinic for an annual check-up. Other issues were brought to my attention, and a few weeks later, I discovered I was losing my cat, my best friend. From the initial consultation for the annual appointment to the emergency visit and then the final farewell, every encounter was profoundly humane, respectful, and full of empathy during these difficult times. From my very first appointment, I felt confident, and during this very difficult period, I was able to find comfort knowing that my pet was surrounded by positive energy and passionate professionals in a warm and welcoming environment until the very end. Thank you all, and for those of you still looking for a veterinarian, you've just found them.
The best clinic for our pets. Warm welcome and lots of empathy from everyone. Competitive prices.
Worst vet ever! Do not bring your animals here. There is no compassion and will let your pet die. They don’t care!
Great clinic! My dog loves Dr Cammisano and her team. They are knowledgable, friendly and take extra safety precautions for my (very dog reactive) dog. We appreciate you!!

I needed an urgent appointment and was easily able to book online the same day, even though it was our first visit.

The initial consultation with the technician went smoothly, and Dr. Cammisano explained the proposed tests and treatments in detail so we could make an informed decision. She was also kind enough to show us the waiting room where Karma would be, which reassured us. The clinic also followed up by phone a week later.

I am very satisfied with the services provided and the reasonable price. My only regret is living too far away to make it our regular clinic.

Thank you to the entire team for the excellent care provided to Karma!

The staff were very welcoming and provided excellent service. It's the ideal place for proper animal care. We regularly see our cats and highly recommend this clinic. They are very patient and kind. Thank you.

Quick appointment and fair prices
I particularly recommend Dr. Veronica Cammisano and technician Katia, who take the time to explore the different options.

A superb first experience! I was very stressed about my cat Phoenix, but I was reassured by the gentleness and clear explanations of Dr. Cammisano and her assistant. A wonderful clinic, top-notch staff who are passionate about animals. Thank you so much and see you soon! Dominique
I got an appointment the same day, and the entire veterinary team was incredibly attentive to my cat. They were caring and reassuring; I felt confident from the moment I arrived.
The best vet in Montreal. Great service and they care about the animal, not the bill. My dog ​​had a wonderful experience despite being nervous; the team took excellent care of him.

This clinic is truly fantastic! The staff and veterinarians are kind, friendly, competent, and genuinely care about the animals' well-being. It's a pleasure to go there. Thank you for taking such good care of my cat, as if he were your own ❤️

Excellent service from the whole team! Even though my cats were stressed, Dr. Cammisano and the technician were very patient and gentle. They also took the time to answer all my questions. I highly recommend them!

I'm very satisfied with my experience at this clinic. My companion, Cash, had one of his legs amputated, and the service and attention were outstanding. From the reception staff to the technicians, and especially to Dr. Rayes, who is passionate about her work. Thank you to the entire team; I feel lucky to have found you. Thank you, thank you, thank you! 🙏🏼

Best veterinary clinic in the southwest! All the staff are attentive, proactive, and caring.
Thank you again to the whole team for all your excellent care.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. If you have an emergency, they have many same-day or next-day appointments available without any extra charges for a prompt consultation. Recently, my cat had a urinary blockage, and the entire team was kind and efficient in treating him quickly. The costs and treatment options are clearly explained, allowing you to make an informed decision for your pet's well-being. Unfortunately, my cat Cheddar had to be euthanized. Dr. Rayes and the technicians were incredibly kind and gentle with us. Thank you for the excellent care.
They have an excellent customer service and really care for the pets

Dr. Rayes was phenomenal with our big dog. Very patient and compassionate, she was understanding of our situation. In addition, the receptionist was super professional and pleasant. When I had questions about the medication a few days later, another doctor from the clinic called me back immediately and explained everything again. All in all, a very positive visit and my baby is doing much better!

I'm so glad I was referred to this clinic. The entire staff is professional, friendly, and, most importantly, attentive. They follow up on my case and check in with me. The prices are very reasonable, especially if you've already been to the veterinary hospital in Lachine.

I wanted to like this clinic since it's very close by. I went twice in the same month for my cat when I needed a quick appointment and my other vet did not have same day availabilities.

The good:

The clinic is new so facilities are clean.

They have short notice appointments, likely since they don't have a large client base yet.

The receptionist and vet that I saw were friendly.

Things to watch for:

Make sure to verify the tests and costs of procedures they suggest.

My first visit my cat was having difficulty walking and so an x-ray was recommended.  The vet wanted to do 2 x-rays, I assumed it was to see the full paw. After asking further she wanted to take 1 x-ray for each front paw to compare. In the end I only agreed to an x-ray for the affected paw. It seemed strange to me to pay for an x-ray on a healthy paw. They noticed a start of arthritis on the 1 x-ray.

On my second visit just under 2 weeks later, my pet was still unwell. They charged me for the full visit fee. This was not a huge deal but know that other vets generally will charge a lesser amount for close follow up and some might just charge for added tests.

On this same visit the vet suggested blood work to rule out kidney issues. After adding a few tests and urine sample they quoted me 760$ for the visit and blood test. I mention that I'm quite surprised by the amount given that generally my bill for geriatric blood test and urine sample from my vet are around 350$. They explains to me that since they do the test in house it's more expensive. I ask whether sending to the lab with results the next day is possible. They said yes for about 150$ less. The fact that the two options were not offered felt frustrating to me. When your pet is ill you are in a vulnerable state and it's not always easy to question tests and treatments.  I ended up agreeing to testing in house to know quickly if he was ok.

Finally while they were taking my cat to the back for blood work (at my other vet they do this in the room with me, this also felt strange) they mentioned that it might be possible they have to hospitalize him for the night to hydrate him if it's the kidneys to flush out toxins.  This is the reason I will never go back here, they quoted me 2500$ for a catheter hydration overnight while no one is in the clinic! With this I'm pretty stunned, they mention they will have to double check the price in the system so possibly this was not in fact what they charge.

My cat's blood work was fine. He did have a series of seizures after this appointment and I brought him to a different vet. I was quoted 2000$ for an MRI. This seemed reasonable to me versus an unsupervised night stay at the previous vet for 2500$!

If you must go here please make sure you don't feel bad about questioning them on tests they recommend and seeing alternatives.

We love this vet clinic! They take excellent care of my senior dog, Gilbert. He often drags us there on walks so he can try to visit the receptionist or his favourite vet tech, Annie. We would trust any of the staff with him, and any future pets we may have :)

Excellent experience at the Saint-Henri Veterinary Clinic ☺️. We are so lucky to have this clinic, which opened in our neighborhood a year ago, and we wish them continued success! The veterinary team is young and highly competent.
The clinic is very well organized; there are never any delays for appointments, which is very efficient and much appreciated when you have an anxious dog.
We have a dog for whom vet appointments used to be a real ordeal, and they have been very accommodating every time, working with us to ensure everything goes smoothly and in the best possible conditions for Leïka, with great gentleness. So far, we have been seen by Dr. Émard and Dr. Rayes and are very satisfied. They offered us appropriate tests to fully understand Leïka's health, at affordable prices that are lower than at other clinics. The veterinarians also don't push for unnecessary products or procedures. Our dog also had dental work done, and we were nervous about leaving her and the anesthesia, but everything was handled very humanely and gently, and we couldn't have asked for anything better. Thank you for your work and dedication to the health of our animals, and best of luck! 🫶
Amazing experience every time!!! They show nothing but love and care for my kitten - and as a 1st time cat owner, they are always willing to answer my questions!
Such a lovely team!

I highly recommend this clinic. I called that very morning and, luckily, there was a cancellation for the day. It's always worth calling, you never know. What I particularly appreciated was the warm welcome at reception and the kindness of all the staff. In addition to being attentive, they are very transparent about prices and required vaccinations. Dr. Katia Rayes took the time to explain the costs to me during the appointment, which allowed me to choose services according to my budget. Even though our pets deserve all the love (and money) in the world, we all know that expenses can quickly add up. I therefore greatly appreciated this honest and respectful approach.

I am very satisfied with my visit and I recommend this clinic 100%. The location is beautiful, and it's possible to park on the surrounding streets, depending on the permits. I personally had no trouble finding parking. In short, thank you again for this impeccable, professional and humane service!

I highly recommend this clinic. The staff is very welcoming. They treated our dear companion (RIP) with great love. The little note we received touched us deeply. Thank you to the entire team at the Saint-Henri Veterinary Clinic.
Excellent clinic with caring staff
Dishonest, unapologetic, money grab…. I may still consider giving them a second chance in the future but If go back I will definitely ask for a different vet/technician.

After a first visit today, my opinion is very mixed.
Premises - Very nice clinic, very new and well-maintained. Cleanliness is top-notch.
Reception - Great receptionist. Very compassionate and personable.
Vet Assistant - Ekaterina is the best! Super honest, very knowledgeable, I enjoyed every interaction with her and would come back anytime if I'm welcomed by her.
Vet - The vet is a whole other story. Very young and obviously barely out of school, the vet was extremely condescending and constantly tried to impose "add-ons." I just adopted my Chihuahua a month ago and I scheduled all his vaccinations, and in the meantime, I took care of his deworming and anti-parasite treatment. My dog ​​is not neutered, he lives alone with us and behaves very well. As soon as she arrived, the vet bluntly said, "You have no choice, you'll have him neutered in any case. We could do that at the same time as the scaling."
Excuse me?! No sane veterinarian would have suggested scaling and neutering during the same anesthetic on a 4-year-old dog. Especially since this decision is 100% mine, and we'll do it in due course.
Furthermore, the person kept pushing Royal Canin food, knowing that it's the most chemical-based and bad food for dogs (I speak from experience).
I had also dewormed and given him flea treatment, but she found fault with that as well and tried to push me to use the clinic's products again.
Just there to make money.
I absolutely do not recommend this clinic because of the veterinarian. Otherwise, the premises and the assistant were great.

We are so happy with the care we have received here after having terrible experiences with vets previously at other clinics. Our pup is an anxious guy and really struggles with being handled and during exam. The vets and the technicians here are incredibly patient and do everything they can to make the experience positive for the animals. They truly understand that some pets find these visits stressful, and do not shame you as an owner, and that means so much when you have an anxious pet!
Thank you for your kindness and patience with our little Rooi!
I found this veterinary clinic at just the right time when my cat needed treatment. Their consistently quick service and support are truly appreciated! Thank you 🙏 …

I love this clinic! Animal welfare is their top priority, and the entire team provides impeccable support and service. We are always welcomed with respect, good humor, and kindness. I highly recommend it!

I've never met a veterinarian like Dr. Émard! Her gentleness, patience, and expertise completely calmed my anxious dog mom heart. She answered all my questions, gave me a clear treatment plan, and made me feel that my little Henry was in very good hands. A huge thank you to her and the entire CVSH team for their exceptional care 🐾. I've officially found my trusted vet for life! Thank you so much ❤️❤️
First appointment for our cat with Dr. Killens Aubé. We received clear explanations and incredible service from the entire team. I highly recommend them!

I came there and they seemed ok, however, I had a horrible experience with dr Killens and am not going there anymore. She was rude and disrespectful to me when I said that I have to pay for my rent and food as she did not consider that I spent for 2 dogs recently a lot of money at their clinic so I will go somewhere else. Not going back there. She was condescending, disrespectful, oppressive and unpleasant to me.
Loved the experience, the prompt communication and I can certainly say my cats loved it too.

THANK YOU SO MUCH. I want to thank Dr. Tétreault for the examinations she performed on Mr. Verdi. I felt her affection and tenderness towards my cat, thank you so much. Following the examinations, Dr. Tétreault gave me excellent advice for the future. My cat is strong, and I'm confident he'll stay with me for a while longer; he's already 16 and a half years old. I also want to thank all the staff. These ladies are incredibly kind, they listen attentively, and they take the time to explain the differences between the various types of food. Always smiling, we received a wonderful welcome. Thank you all so much! 😽
A sad experience made better with the competent and compassionate work of the staff, the follow up is without equal.

We have complete trust in their staff.

Our old dog passed in March and they handled one of the worst times of our lives perfectly with great recommendations and compassion. Case in point, they even offered to stay open late when we had a pick-up scheduling issue.

When we got our new pup last month, it was a no brainer where we would bring her.

Take yesterday for example… we went for a second round of vaccines, and later in the day our girl got stung by a wasp. We brought her back a few hours later because we couldn’t find the stinger and the staff did a quick double check free of charge.

Most vets get the label, like mechanics, of leveraging your love for your dog to overcharge you. This is NOT the case here.

The cherry on top is the staff is “young” (aka relatable and hungry to help) while still being very experienced with contemporary techniques/treatment options. There’s no question or topic we’ve brought up that they don’t have a great answer for (that also aligns with other credible opinions we’ve heard).

100% would recommend to anyone looking for a reliable vet and safe environment to bring their pet.

We live in the area, but will stay here for the long run even if/ when we inevitably move.

Thank you to your entire staff from Pika & Mildred!

A truly caring clinic. I said goodbye to my partner of 17 years at this clinic, which made the experience so much easier. Wow! I received condolences from the entire team in the mail! Thank you for your warm approach during this difficult time.

Had a very great experience at their clinic. I consulted on two different occasions as my regular vet was unavailable. Both time, I managed to get an appointment on the same day. Everyone at the clinic was incredibly nice and welcoming. Treatment options were thoroughly explained to us and the vet was nice enough to get on the phone with us to answer our questions. I would totally go back and warmly recommend their services.
I've already recommended this place to people who don't even have an animal yet. Thanks for taking care of my little guy.

Went to the clinic for the first time this week. Our cat suddenly developed laboured breathing while my usual vet was unavailable.
We were able to get an appointment the same day and the clinic is beautiful and everyone who worked at the clinic was very knowledgeable kind and compassionate .
We received a very difficult diagnosis for our dear Odette but we were incredibly satisfied with the quick diagnosis and treatment etc.
Beautiful clinic, professional and kind staff :)

I highly recommend them! Dr. Émard gave us a warm welcome and really took her time to make my dog ​​feel comfortable. I immediately felt at ease with her and I sensed that she wasn't in a rush to answer my many questions. The technicians were gentle and reassuring. In short, we had a truly wonderful experience! Thank you to the whole team!

I would like to thank the entire team at the Saint-Henri Veterinary Clinic for their professionalism and dedication to our cat, Nina.

Following an obstruction caused by an object, they took excellent care of her with great skill and kindness.
What I particularly appreciated was their attentive and thorough approach: they explored several possible solutions to ensure Nina's optimal health.
You can truly feel that they love animals and do everything they can for their well-being.
I highly recommend this clinic to all pet owners seeking serious and compassionate care.
Excellent welcome, very attentive. Delighted with the professionals at this veterinary clinic for my 12-year-old dog.

I was looking for a clinic where my aging cat could receive attentive care, and I'm so glad I found Clinique Saint-Henri. The entire team—the veterinarian, the technicians, and the receptionists—offers empathy, attentive listening, and extensive expertise. Truly an extraordinary clinic in every way.
Came to this vet because our usual one was fully booked, but the service and care was so incredible we switched to make this our regular vet from now on!

We had a sudden issue with my dog, and our regular vet wasn’t available for a few days. Thankfully, Dr. Aubé was able to fit us in on short notice. The clinic is clean, modern, and has such a calm, welcoming atmosphere. Dr. Aubé was incredibly kind, patient, and attentive, taking the time to walk me through every step and make sure all my questions were answered. Even my dog, who’s usually very anxious, was noticeably more relaxed. She took excellent care of him, and he’s already feeling much better. Highly recommend!

We've brought two of our cats now to Dr Killens and team and they are beyond helpful, knowledgeable, and compassionate. We feel in absolute confidence that our cats are in incredible hands with this team!

I went with our dog to get a second opinion on some health issues. The service I received was extremely kind, personalized, and professional. I immediately sensed their competence and their concern for the well-being of both the animal and us, the owners. They took the time to explain everything to me in detail, and I felt reassured. We are definitely now clients. Thank you to the entire team at the clinic!
A really great experience, the vets are very friendly and positive.
Dr. Émond is clear in her explanations, patient and attentive, and explains recommendations based on science. The receptionist is also very kind. They accept our Trupanion insurance.

We’ve recently switched vets & this team has been nothing short of a DREAM. They are so kind, patient, thorough & not to mention affordable from our last. While it was a tough decision to switch after over 15 years, it was the best decision we’ve ever made. Thank you to everyone at the clinic! We love you!

Top-tier service. The vets, techs & receptionists were all wonderful: everyone was super sweet & compassionate. Examination was thorough & Dr. patiently answered all of our questions. Test results were quick & thoroughly explained. Affordable & modern clinique with a viewing area so you can watch your pet as they're undergoing bloodwork, nail clippings etc. Kind & knowledgeable team, highly recommend!
Excellent new neighbourhood vet, highly recommended!
Amazing vet – caring, knowledgeable, reliable, friendly and professional.

Excellent service. All the staff are attentive, dedicated, and caring. Our cat had a complex medical condition, and the situation was delicate. The veterinarian took the time to thoroughly present the options and explain the treatments. We felt very well supported throughout the entire process.
I got appointments quickly for my two cats. Both veterinarians were efficient and attentive. The staff was welcoming and friendly. Excellent service! I recommend this clinic.

My brother's dog's health deteriorated while I was caring for him, and without the team at Clinique Vétérinaire Saint-Henri, I wouldn't have known what to do. 🙏 You can tell they adore their furry patients and do everything they can to help them. I highly recommend them. Bonus: the clinic is beautiful and the service is impeccable. …

Amazing. Our cat, Annie, has had some chronic health issues, and when we noticed a potential flare we scheduled an appointment to bring her in. Even before the appointment, we felt reassured: immediately after booking, we were called by Jessica at reception to make clear that we could bring her in earlier if need be.

Annie is 12 and has been in our lives for seven years; we've never felt so involved and included in a vet visit as at CVSH. Melanie and Dr. Killens Aube were warm and professional, and took such good care of Annie. We were invited in to look at her x-rays, and Dr. Killens Aube explained everything thoroughly in clear, plain language, while also leaving space for our questions (she also answered them without ever making myself or my spouse feel silly for asking). When it was clear Annie would need to try new food, Dr. Killens Aube even promised to refund us for the food if Annie couldn't eat it. We left with a better direction for managing Annie's care,   and she's been thriving since her visit.

If you're in St-Henri and looking for a veterinarian, I can't recommend the team at CVSH highly enough.
A very good experience. Fino felt confident and at ease. He wasn't stressed and is in great shape. Thank you for the warm welcome; everyone was very welcoming.

We had an emergency - our dog ate something poisonous. I called the Clinique and they were fantastic. Walked me through on the phone what needed to happened and made space for us to come in right away.

They were super gentle with our dog, and very informative to what was happening.

We are super grateful for the quick availability and their work to help our dog!
